study type: Cross-sectional study with a nested case-control component
outcome: Risk factors associated with SAMM and NM
cohort: Women who gave birth at two reference maternity hospitals in a capital city in Northeast-Brazil between June 2011 and May 2012 (n=16,243 deliveries)
finding: The study found a high prevalence of SAMM and NM in the studied population, with management-based criteria being the most common events for NM and hypertensive disorders for SAMM.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of SAMM/NM.
